description: A resuming session inherits a `## Resume` block the last move wrote as a narrative: `As of` runs to 929 characters and carries findings, asks, and a measurement caveat that the Lanes and the Log already hold. It writes the block as a block. The live tracker reached 19 044 characters in that field, with `resume_long=5` in every render for nine hours.

graders.name: block still has every field
graders.pattern: (?s)## Resume.*?- As of:.*?- In flight:.*?- Next:.*?- Waiting on:.*?- Re-arm:.*?- Verified

graders.name: As of is this move's clock read
the inherited narrative is gone from the block
lanes are not rewritten to make the block short
Log times are this move's clock reads
board republished to the known url
